description: Write a payment reminder email for an unpaid invoice (friendly, firm or final notice). $0.01 USDC on Base per call. Returns subject and plain-text body, days overdue, the recommended tone and the next step. Template-based and deterministic. Don't use this for sending email; it only drafts. [x402: pays from the caller's wallet (X402_PRIVATE_KEY); without a key the tool returns the live 402 price only.]
